description: In every \(M\models\mathrm{PA}\), a formula with any fixed finite tuple of parameters holds everywhere if it holds at zero and is preserved by successor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA_induction.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {k : ℕ}
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit)) (a : Fin k → M)
  (hzero : φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M))
  (hstep :
    ∀ (b : M),
      φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b) →
        φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b))
  (b : M) : φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b)
